product.name: GPIL Workbench
product.description: A persistent, browser-first General Purpose Instruction Language workstation.

compiler.name: gpilc-php
compiler.line_contract: One complete event record may span one or more physical source lines.

examples.name: Multiline GPIL tour
examples.source:
event "Arbitrary precision sum" :
  add(
    999999999999999999999999999999,
    1
  )

event "Readable record" :
  concat(
    "General Purpose Instruction Language",
    " remains readable across lines."
  )

event "Space-time container" :
  containerize(
    "alpha beta"
  )

event "Recovered payload" :
  decontainerize($3)

event "Multiline value" :
  concat(
    "first line",
    "\n",
    "second line"
  )
  alphabet "first lnecod\n"

event "Exact proof" :
  assert_equal(
    $4,
    "alpha beta"
  )

examples.name: Logic + semantics
examples.source:
event "Subject" : literal("GPIL")
event "Predicate" : literal("proves")
event "Object" : literal("reversible memory")
event "Triple" :
  semantic_triple(
    $1,
    $2,
    $3
  )
event "Verified" : sequential_verify($4, " !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~")

examples.name: Arbitrary-precision arithmetic
examples.source:
event "Sum" : add(99999999999999999999, 1)
event "Product" :
  multiply(
    123456789,
    987654321
  )
event "Quotient" : divide(-121932631112635269, 987654321)
event "Remainder" : modulo(-100, 9)
event "Proof" : assert_equal($3, "-123456789")
